Messages.Author: Ector
Messages.Body:
Does Shade deal its damage only once per round or it applies for each
strike?

"When the minion with this retainer is in combat, the opposing minion
takes 1 damage during strike resolution {if the range is close}."

Carrion Crows works only once per round, but this is stated in the
card text.

Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
On 27 Oct 2004 00:47:16 -0700, Ec...@mail.ru (Ector) scrawled:



Once per round. same for Murder of Crows, Zombie, Wolf Companion, etc.
and it happens during the 'regular' strike resolution phase,
regardless of when either combatants' strike will resolve. (eg: first
strike will not help the Shade, and strike: combat ends will end
combat before the Shade can do it's damage)
